opening.argument: The interview asks how female role models and mentors have provided strength and support, and its description identifies their importance in building a corporate finance career. The speaker discusses seeking a woman mentor and starting a Morgan Stanley Women's Committee because people were looking for guidance. These are accounts of career development and workplace mentoring, not an invitation to participate in an investment or obtain a benefit elsewhere. Neither the interview format nor the described material includes a request for money, credentials, investment participation, or off-platform benefits. The observable content supports a discussion of professional experience, without evidence of a transaction or solicitation.

citations.quote: How have female role models and mentors given you strength and support on your journey today?
shares why female role models are so critical in building a corporate finance career
I started Morgan Stanley Women's Committee because I found people were looking for some guidance
